## Metadata
Title: Some Geography!
Author: E. W. Fuller
Copyright: New York World
Date: 1914-08-09
Description: A cross-shaped grid, 13 wide and 13 high: a 3-wide arm at top and bottom, a 4-wide arm left and right, AMERICA printed across the middle row as given letters (r7c4-c10). The checkered squares inside the outline are printed as blocks (#). No number is printed on the puzzle; the next week's puzzle calls itself the thirty-second in FUN's series.
Source: Milwaukee Sentinel, 1914-08-09, p. 83
Solution-Source: Milwaukee Sentinel, 1914-08-16, p. 82

heading: SOME GEOGRAPHY!
subheading: Here's a Perplexing Variety of Cross-Word Puzzle for FUN Readers to Ponder Over.
intro: In response to the oft-repeated challenge of FUN'S cross-word puzzle solvers to give them a really difficult problem to work out, the puzzle editor respectfully tenders the above geographical puzzle. It is a contribution to FUN'S cross-word collection from E. W. Fuller of West Forty-sixth street, New York City. Mr. Fuller writes that he is at work on another puzzle which may prove still more difficult to solve than today's.
credit: It is a contribution to FUN'S cross-word collection from E. W. Fuller of West Forty-sixth street, New York City.
